_comment: Rolled-up registry of every item — GENERATED by items/pipeline/sync.py from the per-item items/<id>/item.json manifests. Read this one file to load the whole catalog; paths are repo-relative. Do not hand-edit (edit config/roster.json).

MISC.label: Junk
MISC.summary: Loot dropped by monsters with no use but gold — body parts, hides, feathers, minerals, oddments. Sold at any shop.

SOUL.label: Soul Stone
SOUL.summary: A soul stone dropped by monsters — the card of one specific creature. Merged into a weapon or a piece of armor to grant it the stone's power; the stone is consumed by the merge. `one_per_monster` makes the binding STRICTLY 1-to-1: a stone is dropped by exactly one monster and a monster drops exactly one stone, so the wiki can show the creature on the stone and the stone on the creature. A stone with no monster yet is UNBOUND (it waits for one) — never a second stone on a monster that already has one.

CONSUMABLE.label: Consumable
CONSUMABLE.summary: Used from the bag for an immediate effect — potions, elixirs, food. Consumed on use.

SWORD.label: Sword
SWORD.summary: Melee weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

BOW.label: Bow
BOW.summary: Ranged weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

WAND.label: Wand
WAND.summary: Magic weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

ARMOR.label: Armor
ARMOR.summary: Worn protection. Equipped in the armor slot; can carry merged soul powers.

items.name: Abalone
items.description: Half a shell lined in green and gold fire. Dunedelver turns them up from a sea that dried out long ago.

items.name: Amber Root
items.description: Hacked off a Stumpling's root-leg and glazed hard with amber sap. Warm to hold, and alchemists know it.

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: A single violet point, flat-faced and flawless. Amethyrn grazes on these and swallows the ones it likes.

items.name: Hawk Feather
items.description: Barred brown with an olive tip, and too big for any bird anyone has flushed out of these woods yet.

items.name: Hawk Quill
items.description: A stiff barred quill, blue at the base. Fletchers would pay if anyone could say what it came off.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: Fist-sized lump of glossy black glass, cooled out of some fire-thing's crust. Keen enough to shave with, so don't.

items.name: Black Glass
items.description: Slab of black volcanic glass, faceted and chipped. It sheds off a Magmashell's plates as the fire cools.

items.name: Dark Horns
items.description: A pair of black horns tipped in sickly green. Thornstag drops one every autumn and grows it back worse.

items.name: Onyx Shard
items.description: Wedge of near-black glass with a cold blue sheen, cracked out of Rimeshard's rock. The edge never dulls.

items.name: Rib Cage
items.description: Spine and curved ribs, bleached clean. A Palehusk wore it badly, and a Glowbone would have lit it up.

items.name: Sea Shells
items.description: Scallops and spirals, sun-faded to tan. A Dunedelver turns them up where the sea has not been for an age.

items.name: Glow Caps
items.description: Blue mushrooms on a knot of root, lit from inside. Gnarloak carries a whole grove in its shoulders.

items.name: Blue Scales
items.description: A sheet of blue-green scales, cold and slick. Nothing in this valley wears a coat quite like it.

items.name: Rift Geode
items.description: Split grey stone bleeding cold cyan light from every seam. Golems grow around them and resent the loss.

items.name: Beast Tooth
items.description: Thumb-long ivory with a notched crown. A Palemaw bites once; a Diretusk never has to. Both leave these.

items.name: Bog Slime
items.description: Swamp-green and faintly gritty, with things suspended in it you would rather not name.

items.name: Grave Dirt
items.description: Crumbly dark earth studded with bone chips. Whatever the Palehusk climbed out of, it brought some along.

items.name: Root Bundle
items.description: Brown roots tied off with twine and dried brittle. Whatever woodland lump was hauling it does not want it back.

items.name: Old Compass
items.description: Brass, scratched, and still pointing true. Its owner is somewhere in Palehusk's collection of skins.

items.name: Plume Bundle
items.description: Green, teal, blue and red plumes lashed to a cord. Nothing in these woods wears feathers like that.

items.name: Broken Tusk
items.description: Snapped off at the root, cream shading to brown. The Diretusk it belonged to never broke stride.

items.name: Bronze Knife
items.description: Camp bronze on a ribbed wooden grip, made for rope and rations. The Nightmule that hauled it went feral first.

items.name: Bronze Cog
items.description: A toothed bronze wheel, still greased. Runemane is full of these, and one of them is why it still runs.

items.name: Grain Sack
items.description: A burlap sack of oats, gnawed open at one corner. Sorrel has been carrying its own feed for years.

items.name: Wood Idol
items.description: A squat figure carved from dark wood, worn faceless by handling. Runemane's temple is full of them.

items.name: Dew Drop
items.description: A drop of water that will not evaporate or spill. Dewling wears one like a crown and guards it badly.

items.name: Clear Wing
items.description: A single glassy wing, veined like a leaf. Whatever hatched it is bigger than anything you want to meet.

items.name: Quartz Shard
items.description: Prised out of Mosscairn rubble and Rimeshard ice alike: one six-sided white point ringed with chippings.

items.name: Ice Cluster
items.description: A crown of clear ice spires on a frozen base. It does not melt, and it does not like being held.

items.name: Stone Egg
items.description: Fitted stone plates packed into an oval, shaken loose from a Magmashell. Nothing has ever hatched out of one.

items.name: Bog Worm
items.description: A fat pink worm, still coiling slowly. Mirewart eats them by the dozen and leaves the tough ones.

items.name: Coiled Rope
items.description: Braided tan hemp, chewed to a splay at one end by a Nightmule with opinions. Still holds a knot, mostly.

items.name: Rope Lasso
items.description: A stiff coil of rope with a running loop, chewed through near the knot. Sorrel got loose years ago.

items.name: Tentacle
items.description: A severed coil of violet muscle, suckers still gripping at nothing. Voidmaw has more where this came from.

items.name: Fang Charm
items.description: A fang hung on a leather cord, worn smooth by a thumb. Somebody believed in it right up to the end.
items.waiting_for: a tribe that wears its kills

items.name: Corked Vial
items.description: A corked bottle of something olive and settled. Palehusk took it off a body that had not opened it either.

items.name: Magma Stone
items.description: Faceted like an egg, orange over deep red and split with glowing seams. Fire-things leak these when they crack.

items.name: Red Plume
items.description: A red plume with a pale shaft, bright as a warning. Whatever wears these does not need camouflage.

items.name: Crooked Twig
items.description: One dark twig with a knob at the end. Stumpling sheds a hundred a season and misses every one.

items.name: Bone Talon
items.description: Hooked grey bone, thick and cracked at the base. Fiends and the glowing dead shed them, and the point stays keen.

items.name: Crab Pincer
items.description: Brown, jointed and hooked at the tip. Whatever the swamp blobs swallowed to get it went down sideways.

items.name: Curved Fang
items.description: White ivory going tan at the root, worn fine by use. Cave-jaws and dusk-hunters both leave these behind.

items.name: Diamond
items.description: Cut, clear and cold, throwing light in every direction. Whatever swallowed it did not know what it had.

items.name: Bat Wing
items.description: Dark membrane on thin bone struts, folded shut. Leathery, and off nothing anyone has cornered yet.

items.name: Oak Plank
items.description: Planed dark oak, the grain unmistakable, knocked out of a Stumpling. It walked once, and now it holds shelves.

items.name: Iron Quills
items.description: A cluster of grey spines, hard as nails and about as friendly. Tuskmaul wears a ridge of them.

items.name: Red Leaf
items.description: One leaf gone crimson out of season. Thornstag browses and the whole branch dies looking like this.

items.name: Dented Flask
items.description: A traveller's flask, dented flat on one side. Empty, but it still smells faintly of something strong.

items.name: Dry Grass
items.description: Olive stalks tied off with cord — fodder for a farm that is gone. Sorrel still hauls its share to the gate.

items.name: Rune Locket
items.description: Oval bronze, knotted with spirals nobody reads aloud twice. The Palehusk wore it under skin that was not its own.

items.name: Ember Shard
items.description: Leaf-shaped crystal veined orange and red. It stays warm in the pouch, like the shell it was prised from.

items.name: Oyster Shell
items.description: One half of a fossil bivalve, chalk on the outside, pearly within. The dunes are full of dead seas.

items.name: Wild Herbs
items.description: A fistful of green stalks pulled up roots and all, tied at the base by somebody in a hurry.

items.name: Frost Claw
items.description: A blue-grey claw with rime still on the edge. Bergclaw leaves them in shields, mostly other people's.

items.name: Frost Star
items.description: A six-armed crystal that never quite melts. Winterfang's mane grows them and drops them behind it.

items.name: Beast Claw
items.description: One dark claw with the fur still on the knuckle. It came off a paw the size of a dinner plate.

items.name: Gilded Fang
items.description: Someone gilded a hunter's tooth, hollow at the root and polished bright. Nobody asks whose mouth it left.

items.name: Husked Nuts
items.description: Hard glossy kernels streaked tan and brown, a good fistful. Small woodland things hoard them, and now so do you.

items.name: Ember Dust
items.description: A handful of grit that still glows in the palm. Cinderhowl leaves a trail of it wherever it walks.

items.name: Mandrake
items.description: A knobbly root with legs of its own and a wilted crown. The Stumpling was carrying it, or it was family.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Rubble-grade rock studded with raw gold. It was a Mosscairn's shoulder until you argued about ownership.

items.name: Amber Fang
items.description: Broad amber-yellow tooth, split from crown to root. Even an Emberjaw loses one on the wrong kind of bone.

items.name: Great Fang
items.description: A fang as long as a hand, worn blunt at the tip. Tuskmaul has broken plenty on other people's shields.

items.name: Jade Shard
items.description: Teal-green crystal with a wicked point, prised out of a Mosscairn's seams. Holds an edge and a grudge.

items.name: Emerald
items.description: Deep green and sharply faceted, prised out of stubborn rock. Mosscairn keeps them in its shoulders.

items.name: Herb Bundle
items.description: Long green stalks tied into a sheaf, damp from the ditch some blob had been squatting in.

items.name: Jewel Beetle
items.description: A beetle in green and blue enamel, legs folded neat. Too handsome to squash, too dead to object.

items.name: Ooze Glob
items.description: A palmful of green ooze that keeps its shape and none of its dignity. Alchemists take it by the jar.

items.name: Green Scales
items.description: A patch of overlapping green scales, still faintly damp. Palemaw sheds them in the cave shallows.

items.name: Green Slime
items.description: Half a pond-dweller, domed and translucent, still faintly warm. Alchemists want it and will not say why.

items.name: Green Eye
items.description: A green eye with a black slit, still bright. Mireglare's stare goes out of it about an hour after death.

items.name: Rock Pile
items.description: Rounded brown stones in a heap, which is all a Mosscairn amounts to once the magic stops holding it together.

items.name: Sage Leaves
items.description: Bitter grey-green leaves off the meadow scrub. Good in stew, better in poultices, fatal by the handful.

items.name: Iron Chain
items.description: Three pitted iron links, worn smooth where a harness rubbed. The Nightmule that wore it is still out there.

items.name: Long Bone
items.description: One heavy leg bone, clean at both ends. Gravecharger is missing several and has not noticed.

items.name: Hooked Wing
items.description: Leathery brown membrane on finger-bones, with a claw at the crown. Whatever flies on these keeps to its cave.

items.name: Nacre Shard
items.description: Turn this flake of shell and it shifts green to violet. The dune gave it up; whatever grew it is long fossil.

items.name: Ivory Talon
items.description: Cream-white and curved to a needle point, the socket left ragged. Glowbones and Frostwraiths grow them in sets.

items.name: Jade Amulet
items.description: A green disc with a pale gem set dead centre. Temple work, and Runemane still guards a heap of it.

items.name: Great Pearl
items.description: One flawless sphere, off-white with a lilac sheen. Nobody will say which water it was brought up out of.

items.name: Fern Fronds
items.description: A fan of thick green fronds, snapped off at the stem. Sporehorn walks through whole banks of them.

items.name: Lichen Rock
items.description: A fist of rock crusted in orange lichen. Cragback is made of these, and misses each one when it goes.

items.name: Thread Spool
items.description: Half a spool of plain linen thread. Something stitched the Palehusk together, and it was not a tailor.

items.name: Loose Teeth
items.description: Molars, curved fangs and small incisors, no two from the same jaw. Palemaws and Emberjaws shed them constantly.

items.name: Spine Bones
items.description: Three vertebrae still loosely strung together. Gravecharger sheds them and does not slow down.

items.name: Matted Pelt
items.description: Coarse black fur clumped and matted, with stray quills caught in it. Something out there is patchy now.

items.name: Mint Slime
items.description: Mint-green, translucent, and lit by a pale core. Every pond blob in the valley leaves one behind, wobbling.

items.name: Mire Claw
items.description: A green-grey claw with fen mud dried in the cracks. Mireglare keeps four sets and uses them all.

items.name: Moss Slime
items.description: A green dome flecked with moss, still cool. The forest blobs leave one behind every time they lose.

items.name: Driftwood
items.description: Grey, water-worn branches still furred with moss. Cut a Stumpling down and this is most of what is left.

items.name: Watcher Mask
items.description: Grim steel with cheek guards and a third eye graven above the slits. The fiends that wore it had spares.

items.name: Opal Shell
items.description: A curved flake of shell that runs green to gold as you turn it. The dune keeps giving these up.

items.name: Beast Molars
items.description: Two grinders with forked roots, one big enough for a Diretusk. Both chewed harder things than grass.

items.name: Shadow Claw
items.description: A matched pair of glossy black hooks, sharp as the day they grew. Duskfang and its cousins do not give them up.

items.name: Bone Beetle
items.description: Palm-sized and bone-pale, its plated back mottled tan, six legs tucked under. The valley's small fry all carry one.

items.name: Pale Wing
items.description: Tan membrane on pale finger bones, torn free mid-flight. The gaunt things that haunt the drifts fly on these.

items.name: Frost Quartz
items.description: Ice-blue spires on a common base, cold indoors and out. Rimeshard grows this in its rock and swings the rest.

items.name: Rime Stones
items.description: Blue-white pebbles, a good dozen, that will not melt in the palm. Whatever a Frostling is packed from, this is it.

items.name: Curved Horn
items.description: A pale horn with a clean spiral, snapped at the base. Gravecharger wears a pair and notices neither.

items.name: Grey Matter
items.description: Whole, pink and unpleasantly warm. Palehusk carries spares, which explains a great deal about Palehusk.

items.name: Pale Eye
items.description: A grey eye with the light gone out of it. Palehusk collects them, which is not a comforting thought.

items.name: Pale Claw
items.description: A cream claw hooked like a reaping tool, ragged at the socket. Bergclaw grows ten and uses all of them.

items.name: Moth Wing
items.description: Pale tan and ribbed brown, with a blue sheen at the base. Something big and soft-winged shed it in the dark.

items.name: Ivory Horns
items.description: Four ivory horns splayed from one base, ridged like bark. Fiends and wraiths grow them for arguments they win.

items.name: Silk Skein
items.description: Silvery cord wound tight and bound at the waist, cool to the touch. No hand in Nangijala spun this one.

items.name: Hornet Nest
items.description: Tan paper in banded layers, one dark doorway low on the side. Prised out of a Stumpling's moss, and empty. Mostly.

items.name: Rose Quartz
items.description: A spray of pink spires on a rough base. Pretty enough that people forget what they had to kill for it.

items.name: Pitted Ring
items.description: Thick hammered silver, tarnished and pitted all over, off a Palehusk's borrowed finger. It fits nobody at all.

items.name: Beast Eye
items.description: Whole and damp, a brown iris in a veined tan ball. The fiends that carry spares will not miss this one.

items.name: Prism Quill
items.description: One long quill that shifts through every colour as it turns. No bird anyone has flushed grows these.

items.name: Iris Petals
items.description: Purple petals with pale wedged stems, gathered past bloom. Meadow blobs trail them wherever they bounce.

items.name: Venom Claw
items.description: Pulled from an Ashfiend before it crumbled. The purple hook is fine, but the green crust on the tip is not.

items.name: Void Flesh
items.description: A lump of violet meat that keeps twitching toward your hand. Voidmaw is mostly this, on the inside.

items.name: Prism Plume
items.description: Banded blue through green to red down a tan quill. Whatever grew a tail of these has not shown itself yet.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Thick, red, rimmed with brown fat. Which beast it came off is between you, the cook, and nobody else.

items.name: Blood Gills
items.description: A fan of red frills that keeps twitching after it is cut. Voidmaw breathes through a hundred of them.

items.name: Red Scale
items.description: A palm of deep red scales, each one overlapping the next. Emberjaw sheds them where it basks.

items.name: Cloth Roll
items.description: Coarse grey canvas off a Nightmule's pack, rolled tight and trailing a tail. Tents do not sew themselves.

items.name: Rotten Hide
items.description: Grey hide gone soft, with stitching still holding two ends that never matched. It smells exactly as it looks.

items.name: Rough Stone
items.description: Cracked brown rock with flat faceted sides. Half the things that shed it were walking around a moment ago.

items.name: Clawed Foot
items.description: Three cream claws on a brown scaled foot, cut clean at the joint. An Emberjaw's still holds its heat.

items.name: Small Teeth
items.description: A scatter of little teeth, none of them matching. Small things lose them; smaller things collect them.

items.name: Carapace
items.description: A plate of segmented shell, scuffed from digging. Dunedelver sheds them the way a road sheds gravel.

items.name: Scaled Paw
items.description: Mottled grey-green hide and three pale curled claws. A Palemaw leaves them, and never in matching pairs.

items.name: Horn Spur
items.description: A stub of horn broken off at the base. Gnashjaw grinds its tusks down and this is what falls off.

items.name: Milk Tooth
items.description: A tooth the size of a fingernail, root and all. Something small lost it, and something small missed it.

items.name: Black Egg
items.description: A smooth black egg, warm on one side. Nobody knows what is in it, and nobody is volunteering to wait.

items.name: River Stone
items.description: Worn smooth, grey-blue and cold in the palm. Every pond blob keeps one, and none of them will say why.

items.name: Soft Plume
items.description: A long plume shading violet to gold, impossibly soft. Nothing in the roster has feathers like this.

items.name: Snow Tuft
items.description: A burr of white fur bristling every way, blue in its shadows. Warm to wear, and slow to finish thawing.

items.name: Split Bones
items.description: Cracked long bones, split for marrow by something with no patience. Rotjaw leaves piles of them.

items.name: Gloom Cap
items.description: Fat violet cap, pale freckles, thick lavender stem. It grows on Stumplings, which should tell you plenty.

items.name: Silver Bars
items.description: Three cast bars, stamped and stacked. Somebody smelted these, and somebody else never delivered them.

items.name: Marrow Bone
items.description: Knobbed at both ends and stained where beige should not be. A Palemaw was busy with it before you were.

items.name: Straw Nest
items.description: A knot of straw pressed into a bowl by something that slept in it. Still warm, occasionally.

items.name: Rough Hide
items.description: Pegged square with little wooden stakes, edges left ragged. Somebody began the tanning and gave up on it.

items.name: Down Feather
items.description: One soft tan feather, barbs still perfect. It came off something that flies, which narrows it down little.

items.name: Cobweb
items.description: A torn sheet of web, still sticky at the anchor threads. Nothing in this valley admits to spinning it.

items.name: Teal Quill
items.description: Teal at the base, gold at the tip, and light as nothing. Scribes want the bird; nobody has found the bird.

items.name: Watcher Eye
items.description: An eye that grew its own legs. It watched the whole fight from the floor, and it is still watching.

items.name: Wing Quills
items.description: Three quills in blue, orange and gold, still bound together. Whatever wore them was worth looking at.

items.name: Bone Bundle
items.description: Long pale bones tied off in a bundle. A Palehusk was carrying them, which raises questions about the string.

items.name: Tooth Ridge
items.description: Ivory cones socketed in a slab of jawbone, unblunted. Whatever carried it never needed a second bite.

items.name: Torn Wing
items.description: A small leathery wing, torn at the trailing edge. Something flies on these; nobody has cornered it yet.

items.name: Twig Skimmer
items.description: Four glassy wings over a body like a snapped twig. Shaken loose from whatever swamp thing you flattened.

items.name: Violet Shard
items.description: A wedge of violet crystal with a white heart. Snapped off Amethyrn's crown, which it will regrow.

items.name: Violet Caps
items.description: Three violet caps still on their clod of earth. Mireback grows a crop of them across its shoulders.

items.name: Wheat Sheaf
items.description: Cut wheat bound at the waist, still smelling of a field that nobody has harvested in a long while.

items.name: White Ribs
items.description: A full cage of ribs, bleached and oddly intact. It came out of something that stopped needing lungs.

items.name: Worn Tusk
items.description: A short tusk ground flat on one side. Gnashjaw does that on purpose, to boulders, for hours.

items.name: Worn Band
items.description: A plain band of dark wood banded in copper, sized for a finger that has stopped needing it.

items.name: Tooth Charm
items.description: A tooth bound in cord and hide, meant to be worn. The wrapping is careful; the tooth is not the wearer's.
items.waiting_for: a tribe that wears its kills

items.name: Slit Eye
items.description: A gold eye with a black slit, dry now. Emberjaw and its pale cousin both look at you out of these.

items.name: Yellow Molar
items.description: Thumb-sized, yellowed and worn flat. Grinding teeth like this come out of things that chew all day.

items.name: Yellow Fang
items.description: A long fang gone yellow at the root and brown at the tip. Blightcur's whole jaw is full of them.

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Violet facets around a gold rune, cut from an Emberwing. Hits land arcane, and spells come back to hand faster.

soul.power: +20 arcane damage on hit and -10% spell cooldowns

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dark banded stone lined with living gold, pulled from a Glowbone. Burns with light, and nearby undead go blind.

soul.power: +20 radiant damage on hit and blinds undead within three tiles

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Charred black, cracked open by molten veins. Magmashell's banked fire, and it leaves what you hit burning.

soul.power: +14 fire damage on hit and sets targets burning for 3s

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Black shell split by wide lava rivers, out of a Basalthowl. When it roars the mountain answers.

soul.power: +20 fire damage on hit, and a kill sets everything nearby burning

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Blue-grey and plated like something forged, taken off an Ironhide. Spears skate off it exactly the same.

soul.power: +18 armor, and piercing weapons lose a third of their damage against you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Blue slate cracked around a cold white star, pulled from a Winterfang. It frosts a blade and drags at its target.

soul.power: +9 frost damage and slows struck targets by 25%

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Blue-grey plates around a white star. Cold to hold, and nothing anyone has killed was carrying it.

soul.power: +10 frost damage on hit, and cold targets take 15% more

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Bright green plates with black seams, alive-looking. Its creature is still somewhere in the deep wood.

soul.power: +12 nature damage on hit, and poisons on you end twice as fast

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dull brown plates veined with copper, left by a Puddling. Thickens armor and roots you where you stand.

soul.power: +12 armor and 15% knockback resistance

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Brown stone with a wood grain and two dark knots. Nothing that grows has been caught carrying one.

soul.power: +10 armor, and fire does 15% less to you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Packed grey-green cobbles, unlit as fen water. A Bogstalker's own — blows slide past you, worse in the mist.

soul.power: +8% dodge chance and attackers miss more often in dim light

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Cream stone with a warm gold star at its heart, left by Sorrel. It still knows the way to the gate.

soul.power: +12% movement speed, and you tire slower under a full pack

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Crimson with one spiral rune cut deep. Unclaimed: nothing that bleeds has dropped it so far.

soul.power: Heal 10% of damage dealt while below half health

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mossy green split by a red vein, cut from a Stumpling. It hits harder and feeds the wound back to you.

soul.power: +9 damage on hit and heals you for 8% of damage dealt

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Plated grey rock split by a bright cyan seam of Rimeshard ice. In a blade it bites deep frost and leaves the target wading.

soul.power: +16 frost damage on hit and slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pebbled black stone veined in cyan, the storm inside a Frostwraith. Its lightning strikes, then jumps to the next body.

soul.power: +15 lightning damage with a 20% chance to chain to a second target

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale blue lit by cyan forks, grown in a Voltshell's crystals. Thunder rolls a long way behind it.

soul.power: Lightning strikes attackers for 15, and storms never slow you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Woodgrain runs black through it, all a felled Sprigling leaves. It hardens armor and hands blows back to the giver.

soul.power: +8 armor and 5% of damage taken is reflected to the attacker

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dark green with one bright eye of light at its centre. Mireglare's stare, still lit, still looking.

soul.power: Hits burn for 8 over 4 seconds, and burning targets cannot hide from you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Black stone with a red star burning at the core, pulled out of a Rotjaw. It refuses to stay dead too.

soul.power: Once per fight, a blow that would kill you leaves you standing on one hit point instead

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dark teal plates, always beaded with water. The thing that grew it has not surfaced yet.

soul.power: +10% swim speed, and you breathe underwater

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Deep red, cracked like drying blood. Whatever it came out of has not been brought down yet.

soul.power: +12 damage against wounded targets, and heals 5% of it back

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dark red with an orange star bursting through the cracks. Cinderhowl is cracked open the same way.

soul.power: +12 fire damage on hit, and the target burns for 5 a second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Green stone cracked with pale light, off a Mireback. Mushrooms fruit on it if you leave it alone.

soul.power: Heal 6% of the damage you deal, and twice that standing in water

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Sea-green stone mended in gold, prised from a Palemaw's jaw. Armor holds better, and more coin turns up.

soul.power: +15% gold found and +6 armor

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Gold-cased and cut with a sunburst rune, left by a Runemane. It is still carrying out old orders.

soul.power: +20 radiant damage on hit, and every fifth strike blocks the next blow against you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Cobbled grey rock leaking the green that kept a Palehusk walking. In a weapon its poison layers wound on wound.

soul.power: +13 poison damage on hit stacking up to five times

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Grey-brown and split by dark seams, ground smooth. Gnashjaw wears its tusks down on rock like this.

soul.power: Hits grind through armor, stripping 8 armor from the target for 6 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Grey plates shut around a clot of Duskfang red. It sharpens a weapon and feeds part of every wound back to you.

soul.power: +6 damage and heals for 15% of damage dealt

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Grey stone veined in dead violet, off a Gravecharger. It is still trying to reach a line that fell centuries ago.

soul.power: Charging attacks hit for +25% and knock the target back

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Black and webbed with hollow cracks, the dark that wore Grinmask's smile. Its cuts carry shadow straight through armor.

soul.power: +14 shadow damage on hit and ignores 10% of enemy armor

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: A mosaic that changes colour every time you look away, cut from a Prismclaw. Light bends around it.

soul.power: Attacks refract: +10% critical chance, and criticals strike a second time for half

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Black stone flooded with slow orange veins, quenched out of a Slagfang. Still too warm to pocket.

soul.power: +13 fire damage on hit, and your own wounds cauterize: no bleeding

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mottled swamp-green, all a Mirewart leaves behind. Keep it near and small hurts seal themselves while you walk.

soul.power: +3 health regeneration per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Matte black and light-swallowing, an Ashfiend burnt down to this. It strikes with shadow and can hide you after a kill.

soul.power: +14 shadow damage and 15% chance to fade from sight after a kill

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mint-green with a serpent coiled across it, left by a Blightcur. Whatever it carries, it survives.

soul.power: Attacks poison the target for 6 a second, stacking twice

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Rough brown rock seamed with raw gold, grazed loose by an Amethyrn. Coin comes easier to whoever carries it.

soul.power: +18% gold found and each critical hit drops 5 gold

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Blackened shell webbed with live lava, cut out of a Magmane. A weapon takes its fire and leaves things burning.

soul.power: +22 fire damage on hit and burns the target for 4 per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Grey granite gone green with moss, off a Cragback. It weighs what a hillside weighs, in the hand.

soul.power: +22 armor, and nothing knocks you off your feet

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mossed plates around a yellow-green star, torn from a Mosscairn. It strikes with growth and knits you as you fight.

soul.power: +10 nature damage and +2 health regeneration per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Olive and root-threaded, taken from a Nightmule's stubborn heart. Your blows turn green and your wounds close over.

soul.power: +10 nature damage on hit and regenerates 3 health per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Olive-grey with a fleck of gold buried in the middle. Dunedelver swims through sand and finds these.

soul.power: +12% chance a kill yields a second drop

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: An opal shell of soap-bubble colours. Beautiful, valuable, and belonging to nothing anyone has met.

soul.power: +8% dodge, and the first hit each fight glances off

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale opal that holds a crescent whichever way you turn it. Moonpelt's own, and the moon wants it back.

soul.power: +10% dodge at night, and moonlight closes 4 of your wounds a second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Orange stone forked with white light. It hums in sunlight, and no creature yet has answered for it.

soul.power: +18 radiant damage on hit, and burns undead for another 10

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Chalk-cream and webbed with fissures, pulled from a Diretusk's ivory. It plates your armor against breaking.

soul.power: +12 armor and immunity to fracture effects

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale green plates around a white core, warm as a greenhouse. Nobody has found what grows them.

soul.power: Regenerate 4 health a second, and healing on you is 10% stronger

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale grey and full of slow swirls, all a Nightmare leaves. Hold it and you will not recall your dreams.

soul.power: Attacks frighten: the target flees for 2 seconds, once every 12

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale green plates, cool and slightly damp. Some creature grows these; the valley has not shown it.

soul.power: +8 armor, and moss and mud never slow you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Sun-bleached with a gold heart, wrung out of a Dewling. It makes blows land heavy and leaves them blinking.

soul.power: +8 blunt damage and attacks blind the target for 2 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale blue with a white star locked in the ice, out of a Bergclaw. Cold enough to ache through a glove.

soul.power: +11 frost damage on hit, and hits crack shields: -20% enemy block for 5 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Granite plates seamed in salmon pink, dropped by a fleeing Fluffang. Armor that shrugs off falls and crushing weight.

soul.power: +15 armor and 10% reduced damage from falling and crushing blows

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Deep purple veined in gold, heavy as a crown. Unclaimed, which has not stopped anyone hunting for it.

soul.power: +20% gold found, and merchants pay 10% more

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Cracked dark rock veined with live red, still warm from the Emberjaw. It sets whatever you strike alight.

soul.power: +12 fire damage on hit and burns the target for 4 per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale blue and rimed white, all that survives a Frostling's melt. Hits land cold and sometimes drag the target down.

soul.power: +10 frost damage on hit and 20% chance to slow the target

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Brown stone threaded with living roots, taken from a Gnarloak. Leave it on soil and it takes hold.

soul.power: Regenerate 5 health a second, and hits root the target in place for a moment

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Rust-brown and rough as an old hide, taken from a Tuskmaul. Warbands have broken against less.

soul.power: +15% maximum health, and shoulder charges cannot be interrupted

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Old iron gone sour, weeping copper from every slit. Quillkin leavings, and they rot armor right off a foe.

soul.power: +9 damage on hit and reduces the target's armor by 6 for 8 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Scorched dark red with embers sulking in the cracks, the last of a Slagling. It warms your blade and your hide.

soul.power: +4 fire damage on hit and 10% burn resistance

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Green plates around a glowing core, shed by a Sporehorn. The fungus is steering the stone as well.

soul.power: Hits release spores: 10 poison damage a second in a small cloud

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Deep violet scattered with white specks, dropped by a Duskhoof. Like it, the stone casts no shadow.

soul.power: +12% dodge in darkness, and standing still in shadow hides you outright

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Night-black and star-flecked, prised out of a Balefiend. Void-heavy hits, and now and then you blink in behind.

soul.power: +22 void damage on hit and 10% chance to blink behind the target

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Sand-gold and cracked like a dry bed, left by a Sunscale. It keeps the desert's noon inside it.

soul.power: Attacks flash bright: 15% chance to blind the target for 2 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dark stone webbed in gold thorns around a green heart, off a Thornstag. Flowers die near it, indoors.

soul.power: Attackers take 12 thorn damage, and your hits slow them by 20%

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: A violet stone with one open eye that follows the room. Gloompard is counted in eyes like this.

soul.power: +15% critical chance from behind, and a kill hides you in smoke for 3 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Violet with a dark mouth of a core, cut out of a Voidmaw. Set it down and the light near it goes first.

soul.power: +18 void damage on hit, and 10% of it feeds your own health

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Violet stone cut with an unbroken knot. Scholars want it; nobody can say what died to leave it.

soul.power: +18 arcane damage on hit, and -12% spell cooldowns

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Violet, forked white to the shell, dropped by a Stormcrown. The air near it tastes like a coming storm.

soul.power: +22 lightning damage on hit, and criticals arc to a second target

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: White stone branching with gold light. It belongs to something that has not walked into the world yet.

soul.power: +16 radiant damage on hit, and undead near you cannot heal

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale as packed snow, pebbled all over, dropped by a Snowmane. It walks beside whoever is lost.

soul.power: +10% movement speed on snow and ice, and cold never slows you

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: White stone cut with a frost-rune that keeps its edge. Its creature is still out there somewhere, unmet.

soul.power: Attacks slow the target by 25% for 3 seconds
